company.name: Jeeves
company.shortDescription: Jeeves is a consumer service company that provides repair and maintenance solutions for home appliances.
company.description: Jeeves was established in 2007 with the aim of plugging the gap between the ever increasing demands for quality professional services in the consumer durables market in view of the new brands coming into the country and the kind of service that has historically been available.

productsAndServices.description: Jeeves offers repair and refurbishment services for home appliances, electronics, mobiles, and furniture, covering both in-warranty and out-of-warranty products.
productsAndServices.name: Repair & Refurbish

productsAndServices.description: Jeeves provides installation and demonstration services for home appliances and electronics, ensuring products are set up and ready for use.
productsAndServices.name: Installation & Demo

productsAndServices.description: Jeeves offers extended warranty plans that provide additional coverage for products beyond the standard warranty period.
productsAndServices.name: Extended Warranties

productsAndServices.description: Jeeves provides annual maintenance contracts for continued protection and servicing of products that are out of warranty.
productsAndServices.name: Annual Maintenance Contracts

productsAndServices.description: Jeeves manages spare parts supply, ensuring availability and timely delivery across India through a network of warehouses.

productsAndServices.description: Jeeves offers customer support through multiple channels, including call centers, to handle inquiries and service requests.
